– Creative direction 
EDUCATION

National Institute of Design 
(associate program) (2015 – 
2019) 
CERTIFICATIONS 
– Google UX Design Certificate 
(2022) 
– Adobe Certified Professional 
— Illustrator (2020) 
LANGUAGES 
English (fluent) 
Malayalam (native) 
PROFILE 
Graphic designer with 5 years of experience across branding, 
social media, and print design for D2C and hospitality clients. 
Comfortable owning a brand identity from concept through final 
delivery, and collaborating directly with founders and marketing 
teams. 
EXPERIENCE 
Senior Graphic Designer — Studio Kanvas, Kollam 
May 2023 – Present 
• Design brand identities for 8 D2C clients, from logo through 
packaging and guidelines 
• Create 200+ social media assets monthly across 6 client accounts 
• Lead client-facing brand presentations, translating feedback into 
design decisions 
• Mentor a junior designer on typography and layout fundamentals 
Graphic Designer — Palette Creative Agency, Kochi 
Jun 2021 – Apr 2023 
• Produced print collateral (menus, brochures, signage) for 15+ 
hospitality clients 
• Supported senior designers on 3 major rebranding projects end to 
end 
• Built a reusable social media template system, cutting turnaround 
time by 30% 
Junior Designer — Palette Creative Agency, Kochi 
Jun 2019 – May 2021 
• Assisted with print production files and pre-press checks 
• Designed digital ad creatives for 5 e-commerce clients 
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS 
• Rebranded a regional restaurant chain's visual identity, later 
adopted across 12 outlets 
• Design featured in a regional design showcase blog, 2022 
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 

• Freelance illustration work for 2 independent publishing projects 
(2021 – present)
